title: Oneok Inc. (OKE) Stock Drops Despite Market Gains: Important Facts to Note
author: Zacks.Com
description: Oneok Inc. (OKE) declined 1.78% while broader markets gained, underperforming the S&P 500's 1.49% rise. The natural gas company is expected to report lower EPS of $1.45 (down 2.68% YoY) but higher revenue of $11.77 billion (up 36.34% YoY). OKE holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) with a Forward P/E of 16.39, trading at a premium to its industry average.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Stock underperformed market gains with a 1.78% decline while markets rose. While revenue is expected to grow significantly (36.34% YoY), EPS is projected to decline (2.68% YoY). The Hold rating (Zacks Rank #3) and premium valuation (Forward P/E 16.39 vs. industry average 14.57) suggest limited upside potential in the near term, warranting a neutral stance.

title: ONEOK Announces Pricing Terms of Cash Tender Offers
author: Na
description: ONEOK, Inc. announced the pricing terms for OpCo's cash tender offers to purchase up to $2 billion in aggregate principal amount of debt securities across 20 series of notes. The Early Tender Deadline has passed with the Aggregate Maximum Tender Amount fully subscribed, and OpCo expects to accept and pay for all $2 billion of validly tendered notes on September 17, 2026. The tender offers are scheduled to expire on September 29, 2026, though no additional tenders are expected to be accepted given the maximum amount has been reached.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The tender offer announcement is a routine debt management transaction. While the full subscription of the $2 billion maximum amount indicates strong investor demand for ONEOK's debt, this is a refinancing activity rather than an indicator of operational performance or strategic growth. The company is managing its capital structure, which is neither inherently positive nor negative for shareholders.

title: Why the Market Dipped But Oneok Inc. (OKE) Gained Today

title: Why Is Oneok (OKE) Up 9.2% Since Last Earnings Report?
author: Na
description: ONEOK Inc. (OKE) reported Q2 2026 EPS of $1.53, beating consensus estimates by 10.07%, with revenues of $12.05 billion exceeding expectations by 13.03%. The company benefited from record natural gas liquids throughput and raised its 2026 guidance. Shares have gained 9.2% over the past month, outperforming the S&P 500, though the stock carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating with expectations for in-line returns.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong Q2 earnings beat with EPS exceeding consensus by 10.07% and revenues beating by 13.03%. Record NGL volumes, improved profitability metrics, and raised 2026 guidance support positive momentum. Stock gained 9.2% in the past month.

title: This 4.5%-Yielding Pipeline Stock Just Made a $4.4 Billion Acquisition. Here's What It Means for the Dividend.
author: Matt Dilallo
description: ONEOK is acquiring Brazos Midstream's Permian Midland assets for $4.4 billion, funded through a $9 billion minority equity investment from Apollo. The deal will double ONEOK's processing capacity in the Midland Basin, enable $5 billion in debt repayment, and position the company to accelerate dividend growth while maintaining its 30+ year dividend stability record.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The acquisition is immediately accretive to earnings and free cash flow per share, doubles processing capacity, accelerates deleveraging, and provides financial flexibility to increase dividend growth beyond the current 3-4% target while maintaining 30+ years of dividend stability.

Apollo is making a $9 billion minority equity investment with a capped 7% IRR for nine years, allowing it to capture upside value creation above the cap while providing low-cost capital to a stable, dividend-paying infrastructure company.
